steps.name: Set schedule
steps.do: Open **Set Meet the Guardians talk schedule**. Choose a **Location** and **Talk name**, add recurring **Talk times**, and set a date range including today (**Stops being offered on** as needed). Submit.
steps.expect: Success that the schedule was saved.

steps.name: Map talk visible
steps.do: On **Map**, set **Specific Map** to today. In **Filter:**, enable **Meet The Guardians Talks**, then open the talk marker.
steps.expect: Talk marker is present; tooltip/banner shows the scheduled **Talk times**.

steps.name: Itinerary lists talk
steps.do: From the bottom nav, open **Itinerary**. Use **Edit Itinerary** / **Build Itinerary**, set the visit date to today, and open the Meet the Guardians step.
steps.expect: The talk is offered with the scheduled **Talk times**.

steps.name: Add occurrence
steps.do: Open **Add Meet the Guardians talk occurrence**. Choose the same **Location** and **Talk name**, set **Date** to today, and enter a **Talk time** that is not already on the recurring schedule. Submit.
steps.expect: Success that the occurrence was added.

steps.name: Added occurrence visible
steps.do: On **Map**, set **Specific Map** to today. In **Filter:**, enable **Meet The Guardians Talks**, then open the talk marker. On **Itinerary**, open the Meet the Guardians step for today.
steps.expect: The added **Talk time** appears on the map tooltip/banner and in the Meet the Guardians offerings.

steps.name: Cancel occurrence
steps.do: Open **Cancel Meet the Guardians talk occurrence**. Choose the same **Location**, **Talk name**, and **Date** as step 4, select the added **Talk time**, and submit.
steps.expect: Success that the occurrence was cancelled.

steps.name: Cancelled occurrence absent
steps.do: On **Map**, set **Specific Map** to today. In **Filter:**, enable **Meet The Guardians Talks**, then open the talk marker. On **Itinerary**, open the Meet the Guardians step for today.
steps.expect: The cancelled **Talk time** is absent from the map tooltip/banner and from the Meet the Guardians offerings.

steps.name: End schedule
steps.do: Open **End Meet the Guardians talk schedule** and end the schedule from step 1.
steps.expect: Success that the schedule was ended.

steps.name: Future clear
steps.do: On **Map**, set **Specific Map** to a future date that was only covered by the ended schedule. In **Filter:**, enable **Meet The Guardians Talks**. On **Itinerary**, open the Meet the Guardians step for that same future visit date.
steps.expect: The talk is absent on the map and in Meet the Guardians offerings for that future date.
